summary: Sorts point and/or primitive lists by attribute, random seed, proximity to a point, along a vector, or relative to an object's Z axis. It can also reverse or circularly shift the sorted order.

key_params.name: pointuint
key_params.note: Unsigned integer width hint for point attribute sorting

key_params.name: pointobj
key_params.note: Object used for relative Z-axis sorting

key_params.name: primuint
key_params.note: Unsigned integer width hint for primitive attribute sorting

key_params.name: primprox
key_params.note: Point used for primitive proximity sorting

key_params.name: primdir
key_params.note: Vector used for primitive along-vector sorting

key_params.name: primobj
key_params.note: Object used for primitive relative Z-axis sorting

key_concepts: Sorts the point list and/or primitive list by attributes, position, proximity, vector projection, object Z-axis, random order, or circular shift.
Point sorting and primitive sorting are configured separately on their own pages.
Sorting by unsigned integer attributes can use width hints to reduce GPU sorting passes.
Reverse and shift controls reorder already-sorted point or primitive lists without changing attribute values.
common_gotchas: Sorting changes indices and invalidates assumptions in existing groups, neighbor arrays, and point-index attributes.
Unsigned-integer width hints reduce GPU sort passes only when the attribute truly fits the declared range.
Random sort is deterministic by seed, so preserve seed values in generated repeatable systems.
